visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up, high-angle shot captures a person's hands striking the keys of a digital piano in a dimly lit room. An overlayed rectangular frame displays a still photo of a young man with glasses wearing a graduation gown, smiling at the camera. (2) As the hands continue to move across the piano keys, the central photo changes to show various nostalgic scenes: a young man on a pink bicycle at night, a group of friends lying on the grass together, and three young men sitting on wooden animal-shaped seats in a park. (3) The sequence of photos continues, featuring indoor gatherings with friends, a formal graduation portrait with many students in gowns and caps, and playful interactions. The backgrounds in the photos include university buildings and greenery. (4) The hands on the piano continue their steady motion while the photos transition to closer shots of friends, including one making a funny face by stretching his nose. The final photo shows a group of hands forming a star shape over a table with drinks before the video concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Reflection -> Sentimental Journey -> Emotional Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal musical tribute to past friendships and university memories. By overlaying nostalgic photos of group adventures and graduation onto a live piano performance of a sentimental song, the creator seeks to express longing for the past while wishing their former classmates well in their current, separate lives.
